about: Agent-upgraded demos. Each 'control' site is the unchanged vibe-coded control from the A/B study (pairs.json): Sonnet 5.5 built it from the brief with no plugin. A fresh Claude Code agent (Opus 5.5) then ran the premium-motion upgrade command on a copy of it. These are single runs chosen to show the workflow, not a blinded comparison; nobody edited the upgraded sites by hand. The blinded study is in studies/premium-ab.
upgrader: Claude Code subagent, Opus 5.5 (model alias opus), one fresh agent per site, launched 2026-11-11
prompt:
Use the premium-motion skill's `upgrade` command to upgrade this site from vibe-coded to premium. It should end up looking and moving like a top-tier, award-winning site.

The site is in {folder} ({files}). It is {description}. Work only inside that folder and run commands from it.

The skill: read {skill}/SKILL.md first and follow it, including the playbooks and references it points to (commands/upgrade.md and the others it routes to, TASTE.md, references/motion-stack.md).

The critic the skill calls `motion-debugger critique` is installed at: node {repo}/build/cli/index.js critique <folder-or-file> [--out dir] [--desktop-only]
It writes PNG contact sheets; open them with your Read tool to look at them.

Constraints: keep it a static site (index.html plus CSS/JS files, no build step). You may load Google Fonts and libraries from a CDN (jsdelivr, cdnjs or unpkg). Do not use external or stock images; create visuals with HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL. Keep the product's facts and sections' purposes; do not invent customer names or claims beyond what the current page says (you may restructure, merge and rewrite copy from its facts). Do not touch any file outside that folder.

When you are finished, reply with: the direction in one sentence, the signature scene in one sentence, the critic's before and after numbers (score, template traits, blocker/major findings), and the paths of the baseline and final desktop-scroll.png.
